title: POST /api/encore/requests: 200
description: The same rid sent again answers what it answered the first time. failed: only for a request the Studio took for auto-make and can't make now (a limit, no free graphics card; reason says which).

rid.description: A UUID made by Encore (lowercase, as Python's str(uuid4())).

reason.description: Why it failed (short text, the guest sees it); only with failed.

auto.description: §2.2b party auto-make: present (true) only when the Studio took the request to make by itself; a request that only asked for it answers like any other.

stage.description: §2.2b: where an auto-make is: finding (the video and lyrics), downloading, making, publishing; null when nothing runs.

eta.description: §2.2b: unix time the song should be published (the Studio's estimate from its queue and measured make times), or null.
